recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring two identical mirrored profiles of a woman wearing a dark hat, facing each other across a bright white central void. Overlaid on the portraits are thin, radiating lines ending in small circular nodes, creating a constellation-like effect that emanates from the center. The color palette is muted with desaturated skin tones and dark clothing, contrasted by a vibrant blue for the central typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two mirrored profiles creates a central focal point.
Geometric line overlays contrast with the organic soft-focus photography.
The bright white negative space in the center acts as a canvas for the primary typography.
The dark hats and clothing frame the composition at the top and bottom corners.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale profiles positioned at the left and right edges, facing inward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white space containing the text and the origin point of the radiating lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the mirrored faces, move inward along the radiating lines to the central text, then follow the vertical axis of the symmetry.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white vertical strip in the center, providing high contrast for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated browns and blacks in the photographic elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the central background and light bloom.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cornflower blue for the typography and subtle green/yellow for the geometric nodes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the imagery allows the moderately saturated blue text to stand out clearly.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of a fluid, monolinear script and a clean, geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Continuous flow, low contrast, lowercase-heavy aesthetic.
Sans-serif: All-caps, wide tracking, medium weight, uniform stroke width.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 's' and 'b' have elongated, elegant loops.
The sans-serif 'K' and 'R' have open, modern apertures.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, handwritten script and rigid, architectural sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric uppercase look for the subtitle.
Approximates the monolinear, fluid script style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical image of two mirrored female profiles in dark hats facing each other. Use a soft-focus, desaturated photographic style with a bright white light source in the center. Overlay thin, radiating lines with small circular nodes at the ends, emanating from the central white space across the faces.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center the text in the white space. Use a light blue script font for the top line in lowercase. Below it, use a geometric sans-serif in all caps with wide tracking for the remaining two lines, also in light blue.

verificationChecks: Are the radiating lines thin and delicate?
Is the text color a consistent cornflower blue?
Is the central background pure white?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the central light bloom
Tracking width of the sans-serif text
Saturation level of the photographic profiles
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact handwriting quirks of the script

mustAchieve: Legible typography despite the line overlays
avoid: Harsh, high-contrast lighting on the faces

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the radiating lines do not obscure the eyes of the profiles.
Verify the color harmony between the blue text and the muted background.
Confirm the script and sans-serif fonts do not clash in weight.
recipe.reuseFormula: Mirrored profile photography + central high-key lighting + geometric line overlay + script/sans-serif blue typographic lockup.
